string-array.name: steps_home
string-array.item: Press the phone’s Home button: these big tiles appear.

string-array.name: steps_home_notes
string-array.item: Only the Settings list opened? Tap “Apps”, then “Default apps”, then “Home app”.

string-array.name: steps_notes
string-array.item: Come back with Back: the Messages card shows the messages.

string-array.name: steps_notes_notes
string-array.item: The list of all apps opened? Tap “Home” first.

string-array.name: steps_notes_notes_restricted
string-array.item: The switch is greyed out, or Android says “Restricted setting”? Tap “Open App info” below, tap ⋮ at the top right, tap “Allow restricted settings”, then start again at step 1. Needed when the app was not installed from Google Play.
The list of all apps opened? Tap “Home” first.
